_comment: N1 evidence (handoff line-width-plumbing): a loads-block minimize_plastic job with NON-DEFAULT, DISTINCT wall line widths (inner 0.5, outer 0.4) and 5 loops, so run_info.json is checked to echo the values the user set AND the derived wall_thickness_mm = 0.4 + 4*0.5 = 2.4 mm (the outer+ (loops-1)*inner split), not the naive 5*0.45 = 2.25.
